# OrcaSlicer fixtures

The repository did not contain a local OrcaSlicer export when P7.3 was
implemented. The valid fixture is based on OrcaSlicer's upstream filament
profile structure and is intentionally marked as a synthetic compatibility
fixture until a real export is supplied.

Reference: OrcaSlicer `resources/profiles_template/Template/filament`.

Required follow-up before claiming full import compatibility: replace or
supplement the fixture with a real exported filament preset and manually
import the canonical output into the matching OrcaSlicer version.
